run_compute_metrics_track1: run the compute_metrics function to evaluate Track 1 predicted matches against ground truth CSV
run_compute_metrics_track2: run the compute_metrics_track2 function to match descriptors and evaluate Track 2 results against ground truth
run_plot_pr_curve: run the plot_pr_curve function to generate and save a precision-recall curve plot
run_match_descriptors_faiss: run the script with --track2 to match query descriptors against database descriptors using FAISS
run_knn_match_descriptors: run the script with --track2 and --knn to perform k-nearest neighbor descriptor matching using FAISS
